name: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone
where: North Rim Drive and South Rim Drive, Canyon Village, Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming
blurb: The brink of the 308-foot Lower Falls, the South Rim Trail to Artist Point, and the North Rim Trail past both falls to Inspiration Point.

trails.name: South Rim Trail to Artist Point
North Rim Trail to Inspiration Point

status: Seasonal closure. Most Yellowstone roads closed to regular vehicles on November 1, 2026, so the canyon rims can't be reached by car until spring; oversnow (snowcoach/snowmobile) travel begins December 15. The Brink of the Lower Falls Trail is closed in winter, and Uncle Tom's Trail (passed on B) is permanently closed.

rare.why: One of two river canyons Yellowstone names as osprey nesting habitat; they nest on rock pinnacles in view of the rim overlooks, and the park-wide population has declined (27 occupied nests monitored in 2023).
